headline: No change found that breaks the bot (Telegram's Bot API 10.4 adds features the bot doesn't use, and today's run couldn't open the Binance changelog); the ideas add a warning stage before the daily limit, catch size-ups after wins, and make repeated limit days shrink next week.

ideas.title: Soft stop before the daily loss limit
ideas.why: Today the guard speaks once, when you've given back 5 USDT. Add a first warning at 3 USDT: 'half size, no adding, no new coins', with room left counting your open loss too. You get a nudge while it can still change the next trade.

ideas.title: Catch size-ups after wins, not just losses
ideas.why: tilt.py flags bigger leverage or size only after a loss. 25 Oct started while you were green. Also flag size or leverage going up after 3 wins in a row, and have /tilt show whether your rule breaks cluster during win streaks.

ideas.title: Limit days add up: hit it twice, next week trades smaller
ideas.why: /week counts days you hit the loss limit. Twice in a week and the Monday brief sets size 25–50% lower; three times and the week starts with the bot's paper picks only. One bad day costs a day, a bad week costs some size.
